The default AI (Puter.js) is available keylessly in the WebAssembly (browser) build or when using the WebView Helper (PuterBridge).

To play this native C++ build, please ensure PuterBridge is built and placed in the same directory, or go to Settings and enter your Google Gemini / OpenRouter / OpenAI API key.
